capability_radar.watch: If a new slot times out, bound the rclone call by the remaining runtime budget so the failure gets a typed receipt.

dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT the existing timer and single calendar owner; no new lock or scheduler.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One small contract plus a read-only timeline.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Storage reliability only; no alpha or cashflow claim.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Archive content, receipts and cohort maturity are unchanged; only start times move.
dimensions.mission: Stop the first daily archive run from colliding with the Drive backups.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: 6 h catch-up slots and the 24 h IMMUTABLE_ARCHIVE_STALE alert stay; revert and reinstall the old timer to roll back.
dimensions.owner_operability: A mature cohort reaches Drive about 3 h later (about 04:20Z).
dimensions.red_team: An unusually long weekly full (> about 3 h 45 min) could still overlap; the 10:15 catch-up then recovers within 6 h.
dimensions.research_truth: No admission, cohort or hash semantics change; RPO is still 24 h.
dimensions.security: No credentials, network or writes in this PR.

recovery: Revert, then reinstall the previous timer unit and reload systemd.
